verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs describe continuous queries as SQL statements that run continuously over incoming data in real time, with output written or exported to destinations. Dataform adds scheduled, dependency-aware transformation workflows inside BigQuery, which covers the pipeline/task side of the story. missing for 10: documented incremental-processing semantics (e.g., incremental models or change-based refresh) and independent hands-on corroboration of continuous queries.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run continuous or incremental transformations — streams, tasks, declarative pipelines, or continuous queries — inside the platform

citations.quote: BigQuery continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously. Continuous queries let you analyze incoming data in BigQuery in real time.
You can write or export the output rows produced by a continuous query to the following destinations
Dataform is a service for data analysts to develop, test, control versions, and schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery.
